_doc: One style sheet + seed for the WHOLE asset set. Edit this file; pipeline.py reads it. See references/art-direction.md.

style.light: one soft key light from upper left, long falloff
style.material: matte ceramic and brushed metal, no glossy plastic
style.negative: no text, letters, numbers, watermarks, logos, user interface, people, faces, hands

hero.note: Subject in the right third; the left 40% stays dark and empty for the headline.

plate.note: Single clear subject, centred, breathing room on all sides.

backdrop.note: No focal point; even low-contrast field that text can sit on.

assets.brief: a single brushed-metal ring standing on edge on a dark stone plinth, a thin band of accent light across its inner face
a close-up of fine metal pins in a row along a glowing line on dark wood
soft dark gradient with faint dust particles
